summary: Specifies methods, headers and content types added to HTTP/1.1 for managing resource properties, creating and managing collections, manipulating namespaces, and locking to avoid edit collisions. It is known as WebDAV. It was replaced by RFC 4918.

eli5.summary: Normally a web page is only for reading. This adds buttons for editing, copying, moving and locking files on a web server, so two people don't overwrite each other's work.
